intent: A placeholder menu row shown while the menu's rows load.
typical_uses: A few placeholder rows in a menu whose items are still being fetched

dont_use_when.situation: A loading placeholder outside a sidebar menu

invariants.text: The placeholder is a 32px row with the same 8px inset as a SidebarMenuButton, and collapses to the same 32px square in the icon rail, where only the icon placeholder stays (with `showIcon`; without it the square is empty).
The text placeholder's width is derived from the row's React id, so it varies between rows between 50% and 89% and is identical on the server and after hydration.

good.title: Placeholder rows while the projects load

bad.title: A caption passed to the placeholder
bad.why: The placeholder renders only its own Skeleton elements and drops children, so the text never appears.
